modelReview.summary: The manuscript is a placeholder with critical omissions: no predictive metrics reported, exploratory unbound analysis, potential figure defect, and insufficient model evaluation. Blocked for thorough revision.

findings.title: Stats run is unbound and exploratory, not prespecified
findings.whyItMatters: Without binding to a pre-registered method-selection or analysis spec, the analysis is post-hoc and cannot support confirmatory claims. Risk of p-hacking and overoptimistic performance metrics is high.
findings.actionableFix: Clearly label as exploratory, downgrade conclusions, or obtain a prespecified analysis plan and re-run.

findings.title: Paper fails to report the primary predictive metrics (AUROC, Brier score)
findings.whyItMatters: The paper's Results section only states sample size, omitting the actual outcome of the analysis (AUROC 0.718, Brier 0.213). This makes the paper unreviewable and useless for interpretation.
findings.actionableFix: Add a table with AUROC, Brier score, and their 95% confidence intervals.
findings.deterministicVerification: Compare reported numbers to stats-run.json estimates.

findings.title: No confidence intervals for predictive metrics
findings.whyItMatters: AUROC and Brier score are point estimates; without CIs, the uncertainty is unquantified, making it impossible to assess the precision of the discrimination and calibration estimates.
findings.actionableFix: Report 95% CIs (e.g., DeLong for AUROC, bootstrap for Brier) or provide in stats-run output.
findings.deterministicVerification: Check if CI computation method is documented and results plausible.

findings.title: ROC curve figure has extremely low non-blank ratio (0.024), likely empty or misrendered
findings.whyItMatters: A non-blank ratio of 2.4% suggests the plot area is mostly white; the ROC curve may not be visible, undermining the figure's utility.
findings.actionableFix: Regenerate the figure, ensure proper axis ranges and data plotting, verify visually.
findings.deterministicVerification: Examine roc-curve.png file and compare with data dimensions.

findings.title: Limited calibration evaluation: only Brier score, no calibration plot or slope/intercept
findings.whyItMatters: Brier score is a combined measure; calibration intercept and slope, calibration plot, and decision curve analysis are standard for risk model evaluation. Without them, calibration quality cannot be fully judged.
findings.actionableFix: Include calibration plot, expected/observed table, and ideally calibration slope and intercept in the analysis.

findings.title: Risk score variable source and computation not described
findings.whyItMatters: The evaluation is contingent on the risk score; without describing how it was derived (model, coefficients, predictors), the analysis is irreproducible and opaque.
findings.actionableFix: Document the risk score derivation, including the underlying model, predictors, and validation steps before evaluating performance.

findings.title: Paper contains stale template statements that contradict available evidence
findings.whyItMatters: The paper claims 'No reader-facing paper/manuscript artifact was found' and 'No estimate-like records were available', suggesting it was not updated after stats run. This undermines the credibility of the manuscript as a final product.
findings.actionableFix: Remove or update generic meta-commentary to reflect actual artifacts.

findings.title: No baseline characteristics, outcome prevalence, or risk score distribution reported
findings.whyItMatters: To interpret predictive performance, one needs to know outcome prevalence and the spread of the risk score. Without these, the clinical context is missing.
findings.actionableFix: Provide a Table 1 with cohort demographics, outcome frequency, and summary statistics of risk score.

missingEvidence: Pre-specified analysis plan or method-selection artifact
Confidence intervals for AUROC and Brier score
Derivation details for the risk score
Table of baseline characteristics and outcome prevalence
Reproducible analysis code or pipeline specification
